title: F satisfies the Rim-Schlessinger condition
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file artin.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: On Artinian test schemes V the triple description collapses: Z is either empty or all of V, so F(V) = U'(V) ⊔ W(V) compatibly with restrictions; (RS) for U' follows from the algebraic-stack (RS) lemma, and for W one truncates: with W = colim W_n and V = Spec(A) Artinian with m^n = 0, W(V) = W_n(V), so (RS) for W follows from (RS) for the schemes W_n.
